photos.desc: Axial remains of Rebbachisaurus garasbae. NMC 50844 and the holotype (G-H) are present.
Fossil - Took the picture at Palazzo Dugnani, Milano
Sauropod tooth collected at Aferdou N’Chaft, tentatively referred to Rebbachisauridae

Holotype material of Rebbachisaurus garasbae. A Dorsal vertebra (MNHN-MRS 1957) in anterior view and (B) lateral view. C Scapula (MNHN-MRS 1957) in lateral view. Scale bar equals 30 cm. Abbreviations:
Several assorted Kem Kem Beds fossils, including those of a theropod (A), archosaur (B), and Rebbachisaurus (D).
